facts.text: Immaculata College won the first-ever national women's college basketball championship on March 19, 1972, and captured the title again in 1973 and 1974.

sources.title: Mighty Macs - Immaculata University
sources.quote: On Sunday, March 19, 1972, 11 remarkable young women and their coach from Immaculata College achieved the impossible, winning the first-ever national women's college basketball championship, and against all odds, capturing the title again in 1973 and 1974.
